description: Runway ends. PROVISIONAL DRAFT 24-10-2026: Townsville has two runways, 01/19 (the main runway) and 07/25 (the crosswind runway). Headings are magnetic, the same reference as the other packs and the weather reports. 01/19 (017/197) is confirmed by the RAAF obstacle chart (23-02-2024) and agrees with SkyVector and Flight Plan Database; 07/25 (067/247) is SkyVector only, not cross-checked against a second source. Not checked against the AIP.
